runner.name: LM Studio OpenAI-compatible local API
runner.loadSettings: Existing LM Studio model load settings; not changed by this test.

benchmark.prompt: You are the market manager at a space station. Give a friendly greeting in 2-3 sentences and report current inventory: 1,200 iron, 640 titanium, and 80 platinum. Do not invent prices or offers.
benchmark.outputTokensPerSecondFormula: output tokens / (total response time - time to first generated text)
benchmark.resourceScope: System-wide samples at 500 ms intervals; not isolated to the model process.

samples.outputText: Welcome aboard! As your market manager, I'm happy to share that our current stock includes 1,200 units of iron, 640 units of titanium, and 80 units of platinum. Please feel free to browse the available items at your leisure.
